en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town in a valley surrounded by forested hills. In the center stands a large stone church with a tall nave, steep gabled roof, and tower, slightly elevated on a hill above compact rows of masonry houses. The town has orderly streets, multi‑story buildings with steep roofs, and a river or road curving through the valley. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the front.
